αἴρω: to take up, raise, lift up
αὔω: to burn, light a fire, get a light
βλάπτω: to disable, hinder (Hom.); to harm, damage
βουλεύω: to take counsel, deliberate, concert measures
γουνάζομαι: to clasp by the knees: implore
δίζω: to be in doubt, at a loss
εἰσοράω: to look into, look upon, view, behold
εὔχομαι: to pray, offer prayers, pay one’s vows, make a vow
θεάομαι: to look on, gaze at, view, behold
κεῖμαι: to lie; to have been set/put (as perf. pass. of τίθημι)
κινύρομαι: to utter a plaintive sound, lament, wail
κομίζω: to take care of, provide for
κρίνω: to pick out, choose, judge, determine
λέγω: to say, tell, speak; epic and arch.: pick, gather
μέδομαι: to provide for, think on, be mindful of, bethink one of
μέλω: to be an object of care
μέμφομαι: to blame, censure, find fault with
μήδομαι: to be minded, to intend, resolve
μεγαλίζομαι: to be exalted, to bear oneself proudly
μειλίσσω: to make mild, to appease, propitiate
μετέρχομαι: to come, go among, go after, attack
πέλω: to be, become; Hom. be in motion
παραιτέομαι: to beg from, of; to avert, decline
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
πιφαύσκω: to make manifest, declare, tell of
πορεύω: to make to go, carry, convey
προκήδομαι: to take care of, take thought for
σεύω: to put in quick motion: to drive, hunt, chase away
στέλλω: to set in order, to arrange, array, equip, make ready
συναγωνίζομαι: to contend along with, to share in a contest
σφάλλω: to make to fall, throw down, overthrow
φοβέω: to put to flight, to terrify; mid. to fear
φυλάσσω: to keep watch and ward, keep guard
ψηφίζω: (mid.) to vote; (act.) to count with pebbles
ἀγαπάζω: to treat with affection, shew affection to
ἀνέχω: to hold up; (mid.) endure, put up with
ἀνίστημι: to make to stand up, raise up
ἀναίνομαι: to reject with contempt, turn one’s back on, spurn
ἀναβάλλω: (to throw up;) strike up (a song); delay
ἀποκρίνω: to separate, set apart; mid. answer
ἀσπάζομαι: to welcome kindly, bid welcome, greet
ἀφαιρέω: to take from, take away from
ἄρχω: (to be first) to rule, to begin
ἅζομαι: to stand in awe of, dread
ἅπτω: to fasten, bind fast; set on fire; mid. touch
ἐκδέχομαι: to receive, to take over (succeed on the throne, an argument)
ἐμπάζομαι: to busy oneself about, take heed of, care for
ἐνθυμέομαι: to lay to heart, consider well, reflect on, ponder
ἐξηγέομαι: to be leader of; dictate, interpret, explain
ἐπέλπομαι: to have hopes of, to hope that . .
ἐπαιτιάομαι: to bring a charge against, accuse
ἐπείγω: to press down, weigh down; mid. hasten
ἐπιγλωσσάομαι: to throw forth ill language, utter abuse
ἐπιμαίομαι: to strive after, seek to obtain, aim at; lay hold off, clutch
ἐπιτέλλω: to lay upon, enjoin, prescribe, ordain, command
ἐποπίζομαι: to regard with awe, to reverence
ἐρεθίζω: to rouse to anger, rouse to fight, irritate
ἐρύκω: to keep in, hold back, keep in check, curb, restrain
ἐφίστημι: to set on, over; set in charge of
ἔχω: have, hold; be able; (+ adv.) be; (mid.) cling to, be next to (+ gen.)
ἰσχανάω: to hold back, check; long for, desire (w. gen.)
ἴσχω: to hold, check, curb, keep back, restrain
ἵζω: to make to sit, seat, place
ἵημι: to set a going, put in motion
ὀργίζω: to make angry, provoke to anger, irritate
ὀτρύνω: to stir up, rouse, egg on, spur on, encourage
ὑπεραίδεομαι: feel great shame before, stand in great awe of
ὑφηγέομαι: to go just before, to guide, lead
ὠφελέω: to help, aid, assist, to be of use
